completeness_evidence.finding: Full history lists these four cash distributions and two separate share conversions; no earlier cash distribution is listed.
Lists four distributions since inception, with the same ex-dates and amounts.
2017 annual report section 3.3 states no profit distribution in the preceding three years (2015-2017).
2023 annual report section 3.3 states no profit distribution in the preceding three years (2021-2023).

limitations: Four positive cash events are verified against issuer announcement text; the July 2026 announcement is a full-text republication and the exchange separately confirms its ex-date.

Completeness is cross-checked against two full-history tables and sampled primary annual reports. Not every pre-2024 annual report has been independently inspected; this is not a claim that the entire corporate-action register has been independently audited.

All four distributions occur after the two verified 2015 and 2022 share conversions, so each announced per-share amount is also per immediately pre-event share. Sum 0.389 is a cash-schedule check, not a total-return percentage.
Ex-date is used for research return attribution; actual cash payment is later. Immediate free ex-date reinvestment is a research assumption, not an actual broker cash ledger.
